identity.title: [v0.92.2][planning] Audit and refresh first-pass milestone documentation

values.task_boundary: Audit and reconcile the existing v0.92.2 planning documents and produce a complete disposition of relevant TBD inputs.
deliverables: Aligned machine-readable issue wave and execution specifications
Review handoff with deferrals and operator decisions
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every canonical planning document exists and agrees on purpose, scope, dependencies, sequencing, and planned posture
AC-2: Every first-class work track has a feature document, work-package home, proof expectation, and readiness disposition
AC-3: Every planned issue is one bounded unit of work with a concrete deliverable and acceptance denominator
AC-4: The catalog, issue wave, execution specifications, readiness table, and sprint plan have exact work-package parity
AC-5: The ten-step release tail is consistent across every planning surface
AC-6: Every relevant active TBD source has a source path, status, proposed home, rationale, and unresolved-decision field
AC-7: Unplanned or unscheduled TBD material is explicit while backlog and later-milestone work remains deferred
AC-8: Existing issues and completed work are reconciled without duplicate or reopened scope
AC-9: Links resolve, YAML parses, machine-local paths and unresolved placeholders are rejected, and diff hygiene passes
AC-10: Bounded independent review has no unresolved actionable finding before publication
dependencies: Operator authorization is required before v0.92.2 milestone opening or WP-01 creation
non_goals: Open the v0.92.2 milestone or create its version label
Silently schedule deferred or unresolved work
Run broad Rust or Runtime validation
